description: API safety limits (not scoring parameters; changing them does not change results).
parse_timeout_note: Safety net, not a target: the real 213-page VIT PDF takes 410-600 s to parse locally (image-only pages).
cors_note: Origins allowed to call the API from a browser: the local Streamlit dashboard (8501) and the Vite dashboard dev server (5173). Credentials are never allowed.

dashboard.note: Read-only dashboard endpoints (backend/dashboard.py) serve these saved files; target ids come from config/targets.json.
